project_name: Nexus Pass - Self-Hostable Event RSVP & Payment Platform
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / ELECTRIFYING EVENT BRAND
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a self-hostable, high-converting event entry website and entry pass system. The application must feature: 1) Event Landing Header & Hero with live countdown, 2) Configurable Custom Form Fields Generator, 3) Non-merchant manual payment intent flow (UPI QR, Bank Direct Wire, Zelle/Venmo, Manual Receipt Upload), 4) Instant Hexadecimal Entry Pass Generation with verification status & printable badge QR, 5) Integrations Simulator & Config Drawer (Google Sheets webhook sync, Google Calendar .ics export/add, Email invitation dispatch preview), and 6) Self-Host Zip Packaging & Config Export wizard.

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace
typography.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

surface_strategies.card_style: rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#161C2E]/90 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-2xl p-6 sm:p-8
surface_strategies.hex_pass_badge: border border-cyan-500/30 bg-cyan-950/40 rounded-xl p-6 font-mono text-cyan-300 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(0,240,255,0.15)]

elements: Nav Links (About, Schedule, RSVP, Admin Config)
Payment Method Switcher (UPI QR Code, Bank Direct Transfer, Zelle/Venmo, Cash/Receipt Upload)
Export Self-Host Zip / HTML Package Button

image_urls.alt: Neon stage crowd at flagship event venue

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure contrast meets APCA standard with high contrast text on dark backgrounds.
Do not center-align the entire app. Use left-aligned readable hierarchy for forms and details.
Always set explicit text color on hover and focus states.
Provide clear feedback during payment reference submission and pass code creation.
Add data-testid attributes on all key interactive elements.
